vulnerabilities.weakness: Missing catalog data stops checkout and product browsing
Currency conversion is required for checkout; its failure stops checkout
Payment processing is mandatory for checkout; its failure stops checkout
Shipping calculation is required for checkout; its failure stops checkout
All checkout calls depend on checkoutservice; its failure stops checkout
Cart service is required for checkout; its failure stops checkout
Single replica with no PDB or HPA makes the site’s entry point a single point of failure

prediction.summary: Frontend crash will make the entire site unavailable, causing high error_rate across all services.
Pod kill will cause checkout and product pages to fail, raising error_rate >0.01 and p95_ms >5×baseline.

choice.reason: The experiment killed the only pod of productcatalogservice, exposing the single‑replica failure mode. The catalog fix increases replicas to 2, eliminating the single point of failure.
choice.expected_effect: On re‑run, error_rate should drop below the 0.05 threshold, p95 latency should be near normal, and the service will remain healthy during the fault.
